info.title: Power Platform Capacity
info.description: Tenant-wide licensing, entitlement, and consumption intelligence for Power Platform. Reports what capacity a tenant holds, what it has consumed, which environments and resources consumed it, and how much headroom is left. Read-only, with MCP support for Copilot Studio agents.

post.summary: Invoke Power Platform Capacity Intelligence MCP
post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Copilot Studio integration. Provides tenant capacity and consumption tools.

get.description: Get the tenant Finance and Operations license summary. Returns Has Data false when the tenant has no Finance and Operations estate, so zero counts are not mistaken for a measured result.

hasData.description: False when the tenant has never produced a Finance and Operations licensing report

lastReportRefreshTime.description: When the report was last refreshed, or null when it never was

underLicensedUsersCount.description: Users whose usage exceeds their license

get.description: Get tenant-wide capacity for one entitlement: entitled, consumed, allocated, available, and overage status.

parameters.name: entitlementId
parameters.description: The entitlement ID, for example MCSMessages or AI

get.description: List every entitlement available to one environment with its capacity, consumption, and enforcement rules. Use this to discover entitlement IDs.

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: The environment ID (GUID)

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional OData filter. The filterable fields are not published; prefer leaving this blank.

unit.description: Unit of measure as reported by the service

entitled.description: Quantity the tenant is entitled to

status.description: Overage status, for example WithinCapacity or Overage

enforcementRules.description: Enforcement rule states keyed by rule type

Alert.description: Notify when the allocation is approached

TenantPool.description: Draw from the shared tenant pool

get.description: Combined read for one entitlement: capacity, unallocated headroom, and configured thresholds, with percent used. Each part degrades independently, so check Problems before treating the result as complete.

parameters.name: entitlementId
parameters.description: The entitlement ID

entitled.description: Quantity the tenant is entitled to

percentUsed.description: Consumed as a percentage of entitled, computed by the connector

consumptionType.description: What the consumed figure covers, for example MonthToDate or Snapshot

problems.description: Parts that could not be read. Empty when the posture is complete.

complete.description: True when every part was read successfully

get.description: Get how much of an entitlement is still available to allocate. Call this before increasing an environment allocation to confirm the tenant has headroom.

parameters.name: entitlementId
parameters.description: The entitlement ID. Required: the service rejects this call without an entitlement filter.

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: Narrows the availability scope to one environment

environmentId.description: Environment the scope was narrowed to, or null

get.description: List the consumption thresholds configured for an entitlement. An empty result means consumption is not capped.

parameters.name: entitlementId
parameters.description: The entitlement ID

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: Filters the result to one environment

environmentId.description: Environment the result was filtered to, or null

notificationThreshold.description: Percentage of the limit at which notifications are sent

stopResource.description: Whether the resource is explicitly stopped

get.description: Get licence counts for an entitlement over a date range. Capacity-model entitlements with no assigned licences return nothing.

parameters.name: entitlementId
parameters.description: The entitlement ID

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start of the range, inclusive, as yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to the first of the current month.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End of the range, inclusive, as yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Maximum records to return

licenseModelType.description: License model, for example Usl, Capacity, PayGo, or TenantLicense

continuationToken.description: Pass back to fetch the next page

hasMore.description: True when more pages are available

get.description: Get per-resource consumption for one entitlement inside one environment: which agents, apps, or flows consumed the capacity.

parameters.name: entitlementId
parameters.description: The entitlement ID

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: The environment ID (GUID)

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start of the range, inclusive, as yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to the first of the current month.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End of the range, inclusive, as yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: Token from a previous response

parameters.description: The entitlement ID

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start of the range, inclusive, as yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to the first of the current month.

parameters.name: toDate

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1-1000. Defaults to 100.
